title: Vilay (community health worker, Village 04, Lao PDR)
description: Persona for J2: the community health worker of catchment Village 04 in Lao PDR (Country B). Works offline for weeks at a time on an Android phone (OHS app, community configuration) and syncs when she reaches the health center. Goal: make sure no newborn in her village is missed, even with no signal. Needs tools that work offline, a fast way to capture foreign cards and a clear next step to hand the family. Can register a child and refer, but cannot decide whether a foreign record is genuine. Fictional.
